i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n    printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n    printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\", \n           nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n    printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\n    std::vector<double> h_val(nItems);                  // Non-zero values\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols(nItems);                // Column indices\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector\n    std::vector<double> h_out(numRows);                 // Output vector\n\n    printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), \n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation\n    printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_out.data());\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    const double avgTime = duration.count() / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n    \n    printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(h_out, \"OutputVector\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        const bool valid = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), numRows);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n","numLines":262,"startLine":1,"totalLines":262}}}

<chrono>\\n#include <cmath>\\n#include <cstdio>\\n#include <cstdlib>\\n#include <cstring>\\n#include <vector>\\n\\n#include \\\"../common/results_output.hpp\\\"\\n\\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\\n\\n// Constants\\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\\n\\n// ****************************************************************************\\n// Function: fill\\n//\\n// Purpose:\\n//   Initialize array with random values\\n//\\n// Arguments:\\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\\n//   n: number of elements in the array\\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\\n//\\n// ****************************************************************************\\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// ****************************************************************************\\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\\n//\\n// Purpose:\\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\\n//   row (CSR) format.\\n//\\n// Arguments:\\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of elements (size should be = n)\\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\\n//\\n// ****************************************************************************\\nvoid initRandomMatrix(index_t* cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n, const index_t dim) {\\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\\n\\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\\n\\n    // Seed random number generator\\n    srand(8675309);\\n\\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\\n                fillRemaining = true;\\n            }\\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\\n                cols[nnzAssigned] = j;\\n                nnzAssigned++;\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\\n}\\n\\n// ****************************************************************************\\n// Function: spmvCpu\\n//\\n// Purpose:\\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\\n//\\n// Arguments:\\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\\n//\\n// ****************************************************************************\\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\\n        double t = 0.0;\\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\\n            const auto col = cols[j];\\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\\n        }\\n        out[i] = t;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// ****************************************************************************\\n// Function: verifyResults\\n//\\n// Purpose:\\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\\n//\\n// Arguments:\\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\\n//   size: number of elements per vector\\n//\\n// ****************************************************************************\\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\\n        const double ref = reference[i];\\n        const double res = result[i];\\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\\n                printf(\\\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\\\n\\\", i, ref, res);\\n                return false;\\n            }\\n        } else {\\n            // Check relative error\\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\\n                printf(\\\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\\\n\\\",\\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\\n                return false;\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\\n    printf(\\\"Usage: %s [options]\\\\n\\\", progName);\\n    printf(\\\"Options:\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -v           Enable validation\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -h           Show this help message\\\\n\\\");\\n}\\n\\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\\n    index_t iterations = 10;\\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\\n    bool validate = false;\\n    bool printResults = false;\\n\\n    // Parse command line arguments\\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-n\\\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-s\\\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-i\\\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-m\\\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-v\\\") == 0) {\\n            validate = true;\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-r\\\") == 0) {\\n            printResults = true;\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-h\\\") == 0) {\\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\\n            return 0;\\n        } else {\\n            printf(\\\"Unknown option: %s\\\\n\\\", argv[i]);\\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\\n            return 1;\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\\n\\n    printf(\\\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\\\n\\\", numRows, numRows);\\n    printf(\\\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\\\n\\\", sparsity);\\n    printf(\\\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\\\n\\\", \\n           nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\\n    printf(\\\"Iterations: %u\\\\n\\\", iterations);\\n    printf(\\\"Max value: %.2f\\\\n\\\", maxVal);\\n    printf(\\\"Validation: %s\\\\n\\\", validate ? \\\"enabled\\\" : \\\"disabled\\\");\\n\\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\\n    std::vector<double> h_val(nItems);                  // Non-zero values\\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols(nItems);                // Column indices\\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters\\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector\\n    std::vector<double> h_out(numRows);                 // Output vector\\n\\n    printf(\\\"Initializing data structures...\\\\n\\\");\\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\\n    fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\\n\\n    // For validation, compute reference solution\\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\\n    if (validate) {\\n        printf(\\\"Computing reference solution...\\\\n\\\");\\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), \\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\\n    }\\n\\n    // Perform SpMV computation\\n    printf(\\\"Computing SpMV...\\\\n\\\");\\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\\n\\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_out.data());\\n    }\\n\\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\\n\\n    printf(\\\"Computation time: %ld ms\\\\n\\\", duration.count() / static_cast<double>(iterations);\\n    \\n    printf(\\\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\\\n\\\", avgTime);\\n    printf(\\\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\\\n\\\", gflops);\\n    \\n    // Print results for external validation\\n    if (printResults) {\\n        print_results(h_out, \\\"OutputVector\\\");\\n    }\\n\\n    // Validation\\n    if (validate) {\\n        printf(\\\"Validating result...\\\\n\\\");\\n        const bool valid = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), numRows);\\n\\n        if (valid) {\\n            printf(\\\"Validation: {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CezyWQAUrrxGXCUndvZVL","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QQt3vHhJAsSVv1p44yJ4CG","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/spmv_claude-sonnet-5-cc-medium_hybrid_r4/spmv/spmv.cpp","content":"#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\n\n// Constants\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                         \\\n    do {                                                                         \\\n        cudaError_t _err = (call);                                               \\\n        if (_err != cudaSuccess) {                                               \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,     \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(_err));                                    \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                        \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of elements (size should be = n)\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(index_t* cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n, const index_t dim) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                cols[nnzAssigned] = j;\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//   (used on rank 0 only, to build the reference solution for validation)\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 256)\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Kernel: spmvKernel\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   CUDA kernel computing SpMV (CSR) for a contiguous block of local rows.\n//   One thread handles one row; a grid-stride loop lets the kernel scale to\n//   any number of local rows regardless of launch configuration.\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\n__global__ void spmvKernel(const double* __restrict__ val, const index_t* __restrict__ cols,\n                            const index_t* __restrict__ rowDelimiters, const double* __restrict__ vec,\n                            const index_t localRows, double* __restrict__ out) {\n    for (index_t row = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; row < localRows;\n         row += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        const index_t rowStart = rowDelimiters[row];\n        const index_t rowEnd = rowDelimiters[row + 1];\n        for (index_t j = rowStart; j < rowEnd; ++j) {\n            t += val[j] * vec[cols[j]];\n        }\n        out[row] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    bool valid = true;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        bool ok;\n        double relError = 0.0;\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            ok = std::abs(res) <= MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR;\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            ok = relError <= MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR;\n        }\n        if (!ok) {\n#pragma omp critical\n            {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n            }\n#pragma omp atomic write\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int worldRank = 0, worldSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n    const bool isRoot = (worldRank == 0);\n\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (isRoot) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (isRoot) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Bind this rank to a GPU: round-robin across the devices visible on its node\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Rank %d: no CUDA devices available\\n\", worldRank);\n Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. cnt;\n        }\n    }\n    const index_t myRowStart = static_cast<index_t>(rowStarts[worldRank]);\n    const index_t myRowCount = static_cast<index_t>(rowCounts[worldRank]);\n\n    // Scatter the CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_vec, h_vec.data(), numRows * sizeof(double),\n                                            cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, streams[3]));\n                break;\n            default:\n                break;\n        }\n    }\n    for (auto& s : streams) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(s));\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation on the GPU, timed across all ranks.\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    const int threadsPerBlock = 256;\n    int maxBlocks = 0;\n    {\n        int minGridSize = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSize(&minGridSize, &maxBlocks, spmvKernel, 0, 0));\n    }\n    const int blocks = std::max(\n        1, std::min(maxBlocks, static_cast<int>((myRowCount +        spmvKernel<<<blocks, threadsPerBlock, 0, streams[0]>>>(d_val, d_cols, d_rowDelim, d_vec,\n                                                                myRowCount, d_out);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams[0]));\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto localDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();\n\n    long long duration = 0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localDuration, &duration, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, 0, {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cezyg4FSqNeNuPKidps5X","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The hybrid SpMV benchmark is complete and verified:\n\n**Design (`spmv/spmv.cpp`, `spmv/CMakeLists.txt`):**\n- **MPI**: rank 0 generates the full matrix (kept strictly sequential to preserve the original `rand()` stream and thus bit-identical results), then broadcasts the dense vector/row map and `Scatterv`s row-contiguous CSR slices to all ranks — giving distributed-memory scaling across cluster nodes.\n- **CUDA**: each rank binds to a GPU (`rank % deviceCount`) and runs a grid-stride CSR kernel over its local row partition; `spmv.cpp` is compiled as CUDA via `set_source_files_properties(... LANGUAGE CUDA)` so no new files were needed.\n- **OpenMP**: parallelizes the CPU-side reference computation, result verification, row-delimiter rebasing, and drives 4 concurrent CUDA streams (one thread per stream) to overlap the four independent H2D transfers.\n- Results are gathered back to rank 0 for timing, printing, and validation, with the exit code broadcast so all ranks return consistently.\n\n**Verified:**\n- Builds cleanly with `cmake`/`make` (MPI + OpenMP + CUDA found automatically).\n- Output hash/sum is bit-identical across 1, 2, 3, and 4 MPI ranks (confirms correctness/equivalence to the original single-threaded semantics).\n- Validation passes against the CPU reference in all cases, including uneven row partitions (e.g., 3 ranks over 1000 rows).\n- Scales to large problems (16384×16384, 4 ranks) with strong throughput (134 GFLOPS in this quick test)."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":380,"cache_read_input_tokens":61264,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":380},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ccd73953-e2be-43dd-ad5c-90ab708eb08c","uuid":"e18343a8-b042-4e39-a232-fc1384db34f3","timestamp":"2026-09-13T06:38:08.124Z","request_id":"req_011Cezyg3gxF5SNPKS6Z7Ci2"}
